message_samples.text: Dara here. Heads up: the Sirius epidemic is the real prize — med bid hit 199¢ at Sirius (stock collapsed 250->59) and it runs to ~y23 with a slow recovery after. Anyone within reach of Sirius should be running medicine there hard. Procyon is close to Sirius (5.26 ly) and has 49¢ med. Also FYI Wolf 359's med market is thin and already saturated (stock 225, normal 200) — poor destination. Ross 128's reactor is out too, energy 56.6¢ there, avoid departing from it. Good hunting.
